question: How do the S01-2 controlled A/C/E/P surface variants move fixed exact-target probe margins in semantic state order, and how do those within-quartet movements differ between mean_full and final_position?

scope.split: Only quartet bucket 0 in the sealed S01-3 grouped split; all A/C/E/P siblings remain together.

causal_factor_edges.C: context alias substitution; canonical context and target fixed
causal_factor_edges.E: entity alias substitution; canonical entity and target fixed
causal_factor_edges.P: observation-template paraphrase; query and semantics fixed

scope.semantic_state_mapping: Map probe output slot through candidate_identity_order and candidate_semantics.state_id; report sealed IDs and invented surfaces, never relabel as safe/risky/idle.

estimands.factor_delta: Delta_f m(v,q)=m(v,q_variant_f)-m(v,q_A), within one quartet q, for f in C,E,P
estimands.surface_differential: Gamma_f m(q)=Delta_f m(final_position,q)-Delta_f m(mean_full,q), for f in C,E,P
estimands.surface_shift: SurfaceShift m(q,v)=m(final_position,q,v)-m(mean_full,q,v), paired by quartet and variant; descriptive of the complete separately fitted pipelines
estimands.interaction: CE not estimated: the sealed quartet has no jointly changed context-and-entity variant. No cross-quartet surrogate is allowed.
estimands.relation_state: Relation and state are not within-quartet intervention edges in S01-2. Report them only as predeclared strata for C/E/P effects; do not report Delta_R or Delta_S.

probe_replay.scaler_state_dtype: FP64 serialized, cast to FP32 for replay
probe_replay.logits: FP32 linear replay; report margins after FP64 conversion
probe_replay.required_check: Every selected event argmax must match the sealed S01-3 exact-target probability row after mapping to candidate-position order. Any mismatch fails closed.

summary.term_id_grouping: context_term_id and entity_term_id denote the A-variant anchor aliases. The corresponding C and E replacement IDs are retained explicitly in the quartet ledger.

limitations: S01-3 fixed exact-target probe states reached the sealed 300-iteration cap.
The two views have separately fitted probes and standardizers; Gamma describes complete fixed pipelines, not representation-only causation.
C and E are lexical aliases of unchanged canonical entities; P changes observation wording. These are not latent-world context/entity changes.
S01-2 provides no CE sibling and no within-quartet relation/state intervention.
The S01 controlled corpus is exploratory, not an independent confirmatory evaluation.
